dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Thank you, Master Jean! I'll keep that in mind!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Good, now do it again. I'll help correct your movements.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Hello. Anything I can help you with?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: She's very talented, and a fast learner as well.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Although our weapon of choice... isn't exactly the same, there are always shared principles in swordsmanship. All I did was give her a reminder or two, and she immediately understood.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: All that's left now is to remain patient and practice diligently. With your intuitive understanding, Noelle, techniques like this shouldn't take you too long to master.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Just... Do be careful while practicing, alright? If you want to do weight training, you can tie the loads to your wrists.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: That way, some accidents can be prevented even in the event of, ah... unexpected disassembly.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: I—I'm so sorry, Master Jean! I won't toss my sword into your office again, I promise!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It's fine, don't worry. And in any case, after you spent all that time cleaning yesterday, everything is completely back to how it was.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: But... The sword is still stuck in your office ceiling, and it's too high up to easily pull out...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Oh. That. Well, we can just leave it there for now as... interior decoration, I guess?

choices.text: I'm just here to watch Noelle train.
